collection.title: Porsche Cayman 2005 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Porsche Cayman 2005 to 2012 (987C) model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
